input.summary: Extend the § 23.4 source code licence to Customer's Affiliates on written notice and make it transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition, conforming the § 23.5 transfer restriction.
input.comment: [Playbook] The only licence granted to us (§ 23.4) is non-transferable and silent on our Affiliates, so we have extended it to our Affiliates upon written notice and made it transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition, consistent with the assignment carve-out we already have in § 22.4. We have conformed the § 23.5 no-transfer covenant so it does not contradict the grant.

ops.oldText: M&I hereby grants to Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable license, through the end of the Term, to use the source code (including the right to make modifications thereto) on the terms and conditions set forth in this Article 23,
ops.newText: M&I hereby grants to Customer and, upon written notice to M&I, its Affiliates a non-exclusive license, transferable to Customer's successor in a merger or acquisition transaction, through the end of the Term, to use the source code (including the right to make modifications thereto) on the terms and conditions set forth in this Article 23,

ops.oldText: (1) distribute, sell, transfer, assign or sublicense the source code or any parts thereof to any third party
ops.newText: (1) distribute, sell, transfer, assign or sublicense the source code or any parts thereof to any third party other than as permitted by Section 23.4
